sentences.text: I spent the morning siphoning debris from between the spiderwood branches so nothing would cloud the final photographs. After the awards, competitors swapped trimming techniques over cold noodles, sketching hardscape ideas on the backs of their scoring sheets. Newcomers learn the hard way that a focal point placed dead center costs points on every judge's sheet. The judges docked her two points because the hairgrass carpet had lifted near the front glass overnight. By noon the convention hall smelled of wet soil and glue, and every competitor was pretending not to study the neighboring entries. Photography day means blackout curtains, a rented strobe, and forty minutes of coaxing the rummynose tetras into the golden-ratio zone. Nobody expected the ninety-centimeter iwagumi to beat last year's champion, yet there it sat, first-place ribbon taped to its cabinet. We hauled buckets down the loading dock at dawn, praying the amano shrimp had survived the drive from Portland. "Your negative space carries the whole composition," the Belgian judge told him, tapping the empty sand foreground. His bucephalandra had melted two weeks before judging; he entered anyway. Frag the pearlweed, wait three weeks, pray for pearling on judging morning — the whole hobby in one ritual. A dutch-style entry from Osaka stacked red ludwigia against limnophila in terraces so precise they looked machine-cut. One judge crouched at eye level with the aquarium for a full minute, saying nothing, pencil hovering. Someone's diffuser failed mid-exhibition, and three volunteers with airline tubing performed quiet surgery behind the display curtain. Before the judges' walkthrough, an apprentice wiped fingerprints off the front pane with a microfiber cloth, slow as a violin polisher. Ten entries, one gold — and the tiebreaker came down to whose stem plants showed cleaner internodes under the loupe. Fifteen points ride on hardscape composition alone, which explains why everyone hoards dragon stone like treasure. Competitors traded stories at the coffee urn about carpets that flooded with algae the week before deadline. Did you see how he angled that seiryu stone, or was I imagining the forty-five-degree tilt? Under the display lights the glosso carpet glowed almost lime, and a murmur went through the queue of spectators. What is the meaning of the word tank?
